description: The last few decades have been a period of transition for defense. An increasing number of startups have begun to rival large defense primes, the industry has gradually become a calculus of both hardware and software, and exponential technologies have forced the DoD to rethink how it has traditionally done business. qualityReason: 由DIU负责人及Anduril、Shield AI创始人参与，议题涵盖采购、规模化和技术采用，预计讨论较深入。
